text:
maria_cs: Heads up - prepping QBR packet for SunriseHealth. Their onboarding shows heavy embed usage in week 2. Need finops + eng input on token burn forecast. 

 alex_finops: Thanks. Do we have 30/60/90 burn curves? I'm already seeing a big spike in embeddings around day 9.

 taylor_se: I can pull a per-route heatmap. Quick note: they're on Dedicated trial with batch size 16 which is inflating per-token cost. Recommend a temporary batch cap = 8 to test.

 june_pm: @alex_finops @taylor_se sounds good. Can we get a short action list for the QBR? Also want to capture their feedback re: latency and docs.

 maria_cs: Action items: 1) finops -> 30/60/90 forecast (EOD Thu). 2) eng -> test batch cap impact and report latency delta. 3) enablement -> prep runbook excerpt + how-to for batching/caching.

 alex_finops: On it. quick query I ran:

 ```
 SELECT date, tokens, cost FROM spend WHERE account='sunrise' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 14;
 ```

 Preview: tokens/day ≈ 450k baseline -> 1.2M spike on day 9. Projected monthly ≈ 12M tokens. I'll push a recommended budget alert at 10M/month and a 70% escalation threshold.

 taylor_se: Running a local test of batch cap now. Early numbers: latency +15ms avg, cost -18% on embeddings. I'll validate on dedicated infra tomorrow and share perf matrix.

 maria_cs: Customer feedback snippet: "integrations docs were fine but we need clearer guidance on batching & caching for embeddings." Please include a one-page how-to in the deck.

 opsbot: Reminder: renewal trigger for SunriseHealth set to 2026-05-15. 90-day renewal cadence starts 2026-02-14.

 june_pm: Let's schedule a dry-run QBR Mon 02/09. Alex - bring the spend slide. Taylor - bring perf tradeoffs. Maria - bring the feedback summary.

 alex_finops: Will do. Also adding a "budget alert playbook" slide: steps to set alerts, whom to notify, and suggested thresholds for trial vs committed plans. Draft by Fri.

 taylor_se: I'm also going to benchmark a quantization profile for embed model v1.2 - could reduce cost further without material quality loss. Will include bench numbers.

 maria_cs: :thumbsup: Thanks team. I'll create the QBR doc (shared drive) and invite stakeholders. Tag me if you want changes or need me to call out specific CS asks.

 june_pm: noted - will set calendar invite and include the dry-run agenda.
